create_Joystick_env: create a Go1 joystick environment that tracks linear and angular velocity commands
create_default_config: create a default configuration dictionary for the Go1 joystick locomotion task
run_Joystick_step: run a single simulation step of the Go1 joystick environment with an action input
run_Joystick_reset: reset the Go1 joystick environment to a random initial state with a JAX random key
test_sample_command: test the command sampling function that generates new velocity commands with smooth transitions
